urho3d/Urho3D 1.7.1 (9941b25)

Bundled from https://github.com/urho3d/Urho3D/archive/refs/tags/1.7.1.tar.gz

Stripped:
- CI, Rakefile, Android project, SourceAssets
- Source/Samples, Source/Extras, Source/Clang-Tools
- AngelScript + boost (Buildat uses Lua)
- SQLite, nanodbc (database off)
- bin/Autoload (PBR demo bulk)
- Sample-only Data (scripts, scenes, music, sounds, ninja/mutant/kachujin)

Kept for Lua whitelist / runtime:
- Full CoreData (shaders, techniques, renderpaths, PBR)
- UI, Input, Graphics, Physics, Urho2D, Navigation, IK, Network, Audio
- Lua + LuaJIT + SAFE_LUA, Bullet, Box2D, SDL, FreeType, Recast/Detour, ik, WebP
- Assimp + Tools (AssetImporter for .mdl/.ani); not built unless URHO3D_TOOLS=TRUE
- Data: fonts, UI styles, primitives, Jack+walk (animation), Stone/UI textures,
  Urho2D sample sprites, particles, postprocess XMLs
- CMake modules and host/cross toolchains

Source changes vs 1.7.1:
- Source/Tools/CMakeLists.txt: Urho3DPlayer only when URHO3D_TOOLS (Buildat does not ship the player)

Buildat cmake configures this tree as a sub-build of the Urho root:
  URHO3D_LIB_TYPE=SHARED URHO3D_LUA=TRUE URHO3D_SAFE_LUA=TRUE
  URHO3D_SAMPLES=FALSE URHO3D_TOOLS=FALSE URHO3D_EXTRAS=FALSE
  URHO3D_ANGELSCRIPT=FALSE URHO3D_DOCS=FALSE URHO3D_DATABASE_SQLITE=FALSE
  URHO3D_PCH=FALSE
